item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 8 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 8 #SLPRSD
Issued at 06:45 PM 06 September 2026

Moderate to heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Masbate(CityOfMasbate, Mobo, Baleno, Milagros, Uson, Batuan, SanFernando, SanJacinto, Monreal), #OrientalMindoro(CityOfCalapan, Baco, PuertoGalera, SanTeodoro), #Romblon(Cajidiocan, Magdiwang, SanFernando, SantaFe, SanJose, Alcantara, Looc and Romblon) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Masbate(Palanas, Dimasalang, Cawayan, Cataingan, Placer, PioV.Corpuz and Esperanza) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
